g.text: LLM ROUTING / ORIGINAL INTENT TO ONE PROVIDER

text.tspan: Quint: wrong target / stale route / unknown retry / mixed response sources.
Lean: target eligibility / current-route preservation / original escrow and response-source binding.
After consumption, fallback and reconnect cannot create a replacement attempt or refund unknown usage.
No hidden retry or route mutation
